note: Main-street dressing (set-piece-districts.md): three 3x1 shop awnings and two 1x1 street lamps. Measured 1536x1024 RGBA, five pieces at every alpha threshold 16-160; interiors are alpha 253, not 255. Geometry-first reskin of templates/street-dressing-guide.png (street-dressing-guide.py), 300 px per world cell; every rect here is the guide frame, and the raw came back at the guide's own size. Awnings: the shop wall is the frame's north edge, the canopy runs south over the pavement; they carry no cover and never block, and draw in the roof pass through street-dressing-motions.tileset.json (a fixed overhead part on itself), so a figure under one is covered as by a roof eave. Lamps: the post foot sits low in the cell and the arm reaches north, so north of the frame is the carriageway. Exact prompt in street-dressing.prompt.txt. The rod-and-head lamps first drawn here were cut: from the zenith a pole lying across the ground misreads, so the lamps are the street-lamps sheet, heads only (owner). Their frames remain on the raw.
